rationale: The headline change (AppTabs -> OToggleGroup tab control, data-test rename tab-{value} -> alert-list-tab-{value}, header subtitle + section switcher below title) has no focused spec. alerts-ui-operations.spec.js touches tab switching only incidentally via verifyTabContents()/verifyAlertCounts() and never asserts the composite tab, the active data-state='on' indicator, or the section switcher/subtitle. alerts-composite-ui.spec.js still clicks the stale [data-test='tab-composite'] and is not even registered in ci_matrix.json (orphaned). A dedicated alerts-list-tabs.spec.js is the correct home for the tab migration, matching the run-context spec_path; it must be registered in the Alerts shard of ci_matrix.json.
